name: shepherd
description: PS Vita game-porting knowledge and tools: verified hardware facts, gotchas, proven optimisations, failed experiments, an idea catalog of ~340 labelled techniques, general optimisation patterns, a test-first porting process, and portable tools (import checker for 0x8002D003 module loads, VPK checker, honest run history, read-only log puller, C measurement header), plus a guide to porting a Unity game with the open-source Shepherd engine.
